newsitem.title: USA: CFC Intl plant damaged by minor explosion.
newsitem.headline: CFC Intl plant damaged by minor explosion.

text.p: CFC International Inc, a maker of specialty chemical coatings, said Thursday an explosion in the ductwork leading to an oxidizer caused a small fire at its Chicago Heights plant.

The company said no hazardous chemicals were involved, and no one was injured. Chairman Roger Hruby said no production equipment was damaged. "We suffered only minor exterior structural damage," he said in a statment.
CFC said the cause of the explosion was under investigation.
"We are currently repairing the ductwork and the oxidizer is undamaged," Hruby said, adding, "We are not producing in areas that require the oxidizeer for environmental reasons.

"We absolutely will not take a chance on causing any environmental damage. We are producing in most areas of the plant and do not expect any material impact on sales or production," he said in a statement.
The plant will resume full operation shortly, Hruby said.
